# Welcome to SOPQ (2026-2027)

This is the official course portal for **Chemical Process Simulation and Optimization (SOPQ)** corresponding to the first semester of the 2026-2027 academic year. Here you will find all the materials required for lectures, practical lab session guides (CP), and tracking for the Integrated Group Project (PGI).

---

## Course Timeline & Agenda

Use the interactive timeline below to browse week-by-week topics, view lecture slide links, download lab case (CP) instructions, and track deliverable due dates.

<div id="schedule-timeline"></div>

---

## Communication Channels & Tools

*   **Simulation Software**: We will use **DWSIM** (open source) and **Aspen Plus v14** during our computer laboratory sessions.
*   **Q&A Forum**: You can submit questions regarding the practical cases on the Moodle forum or via institutional email.
*   **Assignments**: All lab case (CP1-CP12) submissions and group project milestones (M1-M3) are turned in through the Virtual Classroom.

:::
